Delivery Methodology

How An Enterprise Engagement Works

From initial architecture audit to sovereign handover, our senior engineering team executes a structured 4-phase rollout.

01

Architecture & Data Audit

Week 1: We inspect your current ERP schema, order pipelines, WMS hardware, and custom reporting needs to formulate a migration blueprint.

02

Dedicated Provisioning

Week 2-3: We stand up your isolated private VPC (or on-premise Kubernetes cluster) with PostgreSQL, Redis, and Edge caching.

03

Cutover & Integrations

Week 4-5: Live data sync, banking API webhooks, carrier routing, and automated test runs ensuring zero data loss or operational pause.

04

Sovereign Handover

Week 6+: Complete source code repository transfer, administrator staff training, and optional 24/7 SLA infrastructure monitoring.
